title: centreon-engine configuration, version 3
description: Configuration of one poller run by centreon-engine (gorgone-rs/crates/centreon-engine), sent by centreon-web through gorgone-server instead of the Engine .cfg files. Field names are the Engine .cfg keys after their aliases are resolved (common/engine_conf/*_helper.cc). Templates are sent unresolved, with their `use` lists: centreon-engine merges them with Engine's rules. Every object accepts only the fields listed here: an unknown field makes the whole document refused, and the configuration in force stays. Version 2 adds timeperiods, check periods, time zones, recurring downtimes and retention settings to version 1, and reads macro values as Engine reads them in its files: `encrypt::` values are decrypted with the key of the engine_context target, `raw::` is removed. Version 3 adds host and service groups, severities, tags, parents, host and service dependencies, acknowledgement timeouts, a service's own time zone and the event log settings; nothing changes meaning, but an engine reading versions 1 to 2 refuses them. Design: gorgone-rs/docs/scheduler-design.md.

version.description: Version of this document format. centreon-engine refuses a version it does not know; this one also reads versions 1 and 2 (schemas engine-configuration.v1.json and v2.json).

id.description: nagios_server.id: the BBDO instance_id of the poller.

broker.description: Where the poller sends its events: what the cbmod file gives Engine.

address.description: host:port of the TCP (BBDO) input of the central broker; [v6]:port for an IPv6 address.

name.description: Name of the broker module of the poller (broker_name of the cbmod file).

settings.description: Global settings of centengine.cfg the engine uses; Engine's default when absent.

use_timezone.description: Zone of the timeperiods of the objects without timezone, in the TZ syntax (":Europe/Paris"); the zone of the engine process when absent.

retention_update_interval.description: Minutes between two writes of the retention file (0: only at stop).

use_retained_scheduling_info.description: After a restart, keep the retained next checks instead of spreading the checks again.

log_service_retries.description: SOFT service states are written to the event log.

log_host_retries.description: SOFT host states are written to the event log.

log_external_commands.description: External commands are written to the event log.

log_passive_checks.description: Passive check results are written to the event log.

soft_state_dependencies.description: A dependency looks at the current SOFT state of its master rather than at its last hard state.

enable_predictive_host_dependency_checks.description: Check the hosts a host depends on at its next to last attempt.

enable_predictive_service_dependency_che.description: Check the services a service depends on at its next to last attempt.

log_level_events.description: Level of the Engine logger: only INFO and lower levels reach the event log.

log_level_checks.description: Level of the Engine logger: only INFO and lower levels reach the event log.

log_level_external_command.description: Level of the Engine logger: only INFO and lower levels reach the event log.

cached_host_check_horizon.description: Seconds a host result stays fresh enough to skip an on-demand check.

resource_macros.description: Resource macros by name without the dollars, e.g. {"USER1": "/usr/lib64/nagios/plugins"} (resource.cfg). A value may be "encrypt::..." (decrypted when a command uses it) or "raw::...".

timeperiods.description: Timeperiods. Each one is also a template, under its timeperiod_name, of those that `use` it.

recurring_downtimes.description: Recurring downtimes (Centreon downtime cycles), scheduled by the engine.

uses.description: Templates, in order: the first one that sets a field wins; custom macros are merged by name.

macros.description: Custom macros by name without the leading underscore, e.g. {"SNMPCOMMUNITY": "public"} for _SNMPCOMMUNITY. Names are upper-cased by the engine. A value may be "encrypt::..." or "raw::...".

connector.description: Accepted for compatibility: the command runs as a plain process.

check_period.description: Timeperiod of the active checks; always when absent.

timezone.description: Zone of the timeperiods of the host and of its services, TZ syntax (":Europe/Paris").

hostgroups.description: Host groups the host is a member of.

severity_id.description: Id of a severity of the same type.

acknowledgement_timeout.description: An acknowledgement ends after this many interval_length units; 0 or absent: never.

check_period.description: Timeperiod of the active checks; always when absent.

severity_id.description: Id of a severity of the same type.

acknowledgement_timeout.description: An acknowledgement ends after this many interval_length units; 0 or absent: never.

timezone.description: Zone of the timeperiods of the service; the zone of its host when absent.

servicegroups.description: Service groups the service is a member of.

sunday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

monday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

tuesday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

wednesday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

thursday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

friday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

saturday.description: HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM...]; 24:00 is the end of the day.

exceptions.description: Exceptions, as the timeperiod_exceptions of centreon-web: the days in the Engine syntax ("2026-12-25", "december 25", "day 1 - 15", "monday -1", "monday 1 january"...) and the ranges.

downtime_id.description: downtime.dt_id: the comment of its downtimes is [Downtime cycle #id].

timezone.description: Zone of the periods; the zone of each host when absent.

host_ids.description: Hosts put in downtime with all their services.

service_ids.description: Services put in downtime, as [host_id, service_id].

periods.description: Periods in the Engine syntax: "weekly:1,7 22:00-24:00 fixed", "monthly:1,15 08:00-09:00 flexible:3600", "nth:last:5 10:00-11:00 fixed" (days 1 = Monday).

hostgroup_id.description: hostgroup.hg_id: no event is sent without it.

servicegroup_members.description: Service groups whose members are members.

dependency.description: A host dependency (host_name, hostgroup_name and their dependent_ forms) or a service dependency (the same with service_description, servicegroup_name and their dependent_ forms), with the keys of the .cfg generator; expanded to one dependency per dependent and master.

execution_failure_criteria.description: States of the master that skip the checks of the dependent: o,d,u,p for hosts, o,w,c,u,p for services, n (none) or a (all).

notification_failure_criteria.description: States of the master that suppress the notifications of the dependent (kept for the notifications).

dependency_period.description: The dependency applies in this timeperiod only.
